chapter: Chicago, Lee Collins and the road
title: Lee Collins's band personnel and Ernest Kelly
summary: Danny lists Joe Robichaux, Fats Martin, Earl Pernell, David Jones and Ernest Kelly, whom he stopped from playing the dozens.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Who was in that band that Lee Collins had with you, Danny? Do you remember?

Well, Joe Robichaux played piano. Joe Robichaux. Fats Martin on drums. We had Earl(?) Pernell on clarinet and saxophone. David Jones on tenor. Ernest Kelly on trombone. Ernest Kelly was a great man to play the Dozens. He'd actually talk about your mother in an uncouth
way right away. But I put a stop to it.
